brief: inline (measurement instruments named by corpus but absent from disk)
outputs_expected: 67 phantom tools named in C8 warnings from node tools/corpus-index.mjs
findings: Baseline: node tools/corpus-index.mjs reports 67 phantom tools (C8), 0 errors.

build-viability.mjs DONE. Imports the SHIPPING predicates (sheet.js composeCharacter; gate.js FactionGates/canOffer/canResolve; rules.js computeDamage; resolve.js mitigate; reaction.js derivedDisposition) rather than reimplementing them. --self-test PASSES 8/8 and falsifies ALL FOUR criteria independently.
Real-data result: 540/540 viable, exit 0. All-true is only credible because the fixture overlays prove it can say no (RI-MTH06 M3).

DATA DEFECT: regions.json declares no `tier` on any of its 13 regions and encounters.json declares none either, so RI-CHR01 criterion 4's 'tier-5 region' has NO REFERENT in shipped data. Tool substitutes every non-prop enemy at the highest shipped enemy tier (champion_hist_marked, cst_sap_speaker; both tier=elite) and prints the substitution on every run.
DATA DEFECT: progression/levels.json stops at level 5 (declared wave-1 skeleton) so there is no shipped level->attribute curve for the level-55 projection. Model parameters declared in report.model.

DATA DEFECT: progression/factions.json holds 2 factions (house-dres, shadowscale-order) which appear NOWHERE in quests/faction-gates.json's 9 ladders. The two files disagree about which factions exist.
game/src/sim/quest/gate.js exports FactionGates, canOffer, canResolve - the shipping gate predicates. Any tool asking about gates should import these, not reimplement.

Harness surface is 264 methods. Includes gamepad, gamepadPoll, getUIState, setUIVisible, getPerfStats, stallMainThread, getStorageInfo, listSaveSlots, screenshot, getCaptureState, streamAround, advanceWallClock - the journey/platform/ui tools have real seams.
next_step: tools/journey/journey-run.mjs (+beat-extract, gamepad-shim, cadence, competence) - unblocks all 9 RI-JRN items
notes_for_successor: build-viability is complete and self-testing. Do not rewrite it. Its --fixture keys (tier5_damage_multiplier, tier5_hp_multiplier, player_damage_multiplier, quest_disposition_floor, impossible_resolution_gate, faction_rank5_attribute_floor) are the falsification harness; keep them all.
